Victor Wembanyama joins HISTORIC company! Wemby recorded his second career game with at least 40 points, 10 rebounds and 8 blocks, becoming just the third player in NBA history with multiple such performances since blocks became an official statistic in 1973-74. Watch the highlights from his incredible performance on both ends!
